periodBasis: UTC calendar year; local times are available using the stated time zone

quality.seasonalEligibilityRule: At least 75% valid hourly readings in every UTC calendar month
quality.unitNote: OpenAQ PM2.5 mass concentration in micrograms per cubic metre
quality.sourceTimestamps: Offset-aware archive measurement timestamps retained at their reported UTC hour without rounding
quality.license: US Public Domain as shown on the OpenAQ location page
quality.ratificationStatus: Not supplied in the archived AirNow/OpenAQ rows
quality.spatialScope: One monitor; not a citywide or population-weighted estimate
